gloss: post-dating (writing a future date on a document)

definitions.gloss: post-dating; writing a future date on a document
definitions.explanation: The practice of putting a date later than the current one on a document — most commonly a check or a contract — so that it takes effect from that later date. Used in banking, accounting, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {先日付|さきづけ}の{小切手|こぎって}。
{契約書|けいやくしょ}を{先日付|さきづけ}で{作成|さくせい}する。
examples.english: To draw up the contract with a future date.

examples.japanese: {取引先|とりひきさき}から{先日付|さきづけ}{小切手|こぎって}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: We received a post-dated check from our business partner.

examples.japanese: {先日付|さきづけ}{小切手|こぎって}は{記載|きさい}の{日付|ひづけ}まで{現金化|げんきんか}できない{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: In some cases, a post-dated check cannot be cashed until the date written on it.

notes:
Composed of {先|さき} (ahead; later in time) and {日付|ひづけ} (date; dating), with rendaku changing ひづけ to づけ. Literally "an ahead-in-time date." The antonym is {後日付|あとひづけ} or {遡及|そきゅう}{日付|ひづけ} (back-dating).

USAGE:
A specialized business and banking term. It appears most often in {先日付|さきづけ}{小切手|こぎって} (post-dated check), a common practice in Japan where a supplier accepts a check dated for a future settlement day. Also used for contracts, invoices, and receipts when the effective date is intentionally set later than the signing date. Rare in everyday conversation — outside of business contexts, people simply say {日付|ひづけ}を{先|さき}にする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先日付|さきづけ}{小切手|こぎって}: post-dated check
- {先日付|さきづけ}で{発行|はっこう}する: to issue with a future date
- {先日付|さきづけ}の{契約書|けいやくしょ}: a post-dated contract
- {先日付|さきづけ}を{認|みと}める: to accept post-dating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後日付|あとひづけ}・バックデート: back-dating — the opposite practice, writing an earlier date than the current one
- {日付|ひづけ}: date — the neutral general term
- {約束手形|やくそくてがた}: promissory note — a related instrument, but with its own legal framework
- {期日|きじつ}{指定|してい}: specifying a due date — a broader concept that covers post-dating and other date-related arrangements
